resolved_conflicts.explanation: The page header says Louisiana Forest Service; the survey text on the same page says Louisiana State Forestry Service. Both point to the state forestry agency. The record uses the header name.

sources.title: List of fire lookout towers in Louisiana

notes_for_editor: Thin record. No build date, staffing, fires, or removal date found in the sources read. Torn-down status and the 2012 USGS label come from Wikipedia; the 1949 map is a Pastmaps reproduction, not checked against the USGS original. The survey text on the page is undated; its bench mark is stamped 1938, which does not date the tower itself. Not on the firetower.org Louisiana register. Community Facebook posts were not used.
